title: Identifying a Conic from its Polar Equation
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Identify the conic r = 12 / (3 + 2 cos theta), and find its eccentricity and directrix.
finalAnswer: \text{Ellipse with } e = \frac{2}{3} \text{ and vertical directrix } x = 6

steps.title: Divide Numerator and Denominator by 3
steps.why: Standard polar conic form ed / (1 + e cos theta).

steps.title: Identify Eccentricity e and Directrix d
steps.explanation: Since denominator has + e cos(theta), directrix is vertical line x = d = 6.
